title: Lucky Thirteen Lemon Sherbets Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Lemon Sherbets brings a nostalgic sweet shop classic to life with sharp, zesty, sugary citrus flavour shot through with the fizz and tickle of refreshing sherbet. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend fuses fantastic flavour and cloud production, while the high nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for newer ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
